title: Quants | The Alchemists of Wall Street | VPRO documentary
summary: A VPRO documentary on quantitative analysts who designed the mathematical models and high-speed trading systems behind modern finance. It features figures such as Paul Wilmott and asks what risks come from treating markets as a machine.
why: HN recommends it as an insider-style look at quants and high-frequency trading and their effect on markets.

quote.text: just to get an insider look into quant traders and the effect HFT can have on the market, I also recommend these two short documentaries
